# Preface {.unnumbered}

## Who this book is for

This book grew out of an Applied NLP course at METU (ODTÜ) taught to
engineers from *other* disciplines — chemical, industrial, civil, electrical
— and to statistics students. It assumes you are comfortable with
probability, linear algebra at the level of @sec-math-refresher, and basic
Python. It does **not** assume data structures, algorithms courses, or any
prior machine learning.

Two promises follow from that audience:

1. **Statistics first.** Every new idea is introduced through something you
   already trust — estimators, regression, weighted averages — before it
   gets its deep-learning name.
2. **Applied means applied.** Each part ends in something you can run,
   evaluate, and defend in front of your own organization.

## How to read it

Chapters are sequential through Part II, then Part III chapters can be read
in almost any order. Interactive widgets run in the browser; executable
chapters link to notebooks you can open in Colab. Exercises are few and
deliberately open-ended — they are the course's homework seeds.

## About updates

This is a living book. Substantive changes are recorded in the
[update log](index.qmd#updates), and the Git history is the full audit
trail. If you cite the book, include the access date.

## Türkçe okuyucular için not {.unnumbered}

Bu kitabın Türkçe sürümü hazırlanıyor. İngilizce sürümdeki bölümler
olgunlaştıkça Türkçeye aktarılacak; terimlerin iki dildeki karşılıkları için
şimdiden @sec-glossary bölümüne bakabilirsiniz.
